plan.empty: Nothing planned yet. Add the first post or task you want.
plan.day_empty: Nothing planned. Add to plan puts something on this day.
plan.link: Link to your photos or designs (optional)
plan.help_post: A post you want Mingla to help with. It goes on Mingla's content calendar.
plan.help_task: Something to get done. Mingla gets it as a task.
plan.saved: Saved. Your plan is up to date.
plan.err_title_length: Say what it is in 3 to 160 characters.
plan.err_date_past: Pick today or a later date.
plan.err_note: A note is up to 500 characters.
plan.err_duplicate: Something with this name is already planned. Change the name a little.
plan.err_too_many: You've added a lot today. Try again tomorrow.
plan.err_changes: You've made a lot of changes just now. Try again in an hour.
plan.err_no_host_card: Mingla hasn't set up your brand yet. Message the Brand group instead.
plan.err_read_only: You can see this plan. Ask your brand admin to let you change it.
plan.err_locked: Mingla is already working on this. Reply in the chat to change it.
plan.err_gone: This item is not on your plan.
plan.added_post: Added to your plan. Mingla sees it on their Calendar.
plan.added_task: Added to your plan. Mingla has it as a task.
